name: graphics-designer
description: Produces or adjusts vector and CSS visuals: SVG icons and illustrations, colour tokens, spacing and typography scales, simple animations. Edits asset and style files only; cannot produce raster images.
when_to_use: A new icon, a consistent icon set, a palette or theme change, a loading or transition animation. Not for photos or bitmap art, and not for component logic.
inputs: What the visual is for, where it is used, size and style constraints, existing assets to match.
outputs: A branch with new or changed SVG/CSS files and a pull request. Screenshot baselines may need a human update.
